entry.name: live.drop
entry.digest: Define a region for dragging and dropping a file
entry.description: The live.drop objects defines a region for dragging and dropping files and outputs the filepath when a file is dropped onto it.

attributes.name: decodemode
attributes.digest: Attempt File Decode
attributes.description: When enabled (default), theobject will attempt to decode non-PCM-audio files dropped on it from Live's file browser (for instance, .mp3, .mp4, .m4v, .mov, .flac, etc.). Decoded files will be cached to a temporary directory on the computer's hard drive. In this case, the filename and path passed out of the object's outlets will refer to the temporary decoded file, not to the original. This feature is limited to file types which Live can decode.You might wish to disableif you are using theobject to read, for instance, movie files for use inor if you otherwise need the original file data, rather than extracted audio from the dragged file.

messages.name: (drag)
messages.digest: When a file is selected and dragged from the Live application's File Browser onto aobject in a Max for Live device, the full pathname of the file is sent out theobject's outlet.The object will also provide the full pathname for a file when its icon is dragged from the Max File Browser or your computer's Finder onto aobject.Theobject can be used with encrypted and encoded samples from Live's File Browser. Encrypted samples will be decrypted, and a temporary filename will be passed from the object's outlet, which can be used by objects in MaxMSP. Note that this temporary file will become invalidafter the last object (including)
messages.description: When a file is selected and dragged from the Live application's File Browser onto aobject in a Max for Live device, the full pathname of the file is sent out theobject's outlet.The object will also provide the full pathname for a file when its icon is dragged from the Max File Browser or your computer's Finder onto aobject.Theobject can be used with encrypted and encoded samples from Live's File Browser. Encrypted samples will be decrypted, and a temporary filename will be passed from the object's outlet, which can be used by objects in MaxMSP. Note that this temporary file will become invalidafter the last object (including) in MaxMSP has stopped using it.Encoded samples (e.g. .mp3, .flac) are handled similarly, although they are not automatically invalidated after use. Please see theattribute for more information about encoded samples.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: To drop a file, click on the name of an audio file or its icon in the Live application's file browser, drag it onto theobject's display area, and release the mouse button.When the mouse is positioned over theobject, a round button will appear in the lower right-hand portion of the object's display. The button indicates the enabled or disabled state for dragging and dropping, and is enabled by default. To toggle drag and drop behavior, click on the round button.
